title: The Green Season: Why It Can Be the Best Time
excerpt: The green season (November to May) is underrated. Fewer visitors, newborn animals and lush landscapes.
body:
## What is the green season?

The period with rain: short rains in November–December, long rains from mid-March to May. January and February are often dry in between.

## Benefits

- **Fewer visitors.**
- **Babies:** calving season in the south.
- **Birds:** migratory species.
- **Landscapes:** green and photogenic.
- **Prices:** lower at some camps.

## Downsides

- Rain, especially in April and May.
- Some camps close.
- Animals spread out more in some parks.

## Best green-season destinations

Southern Serengeti and Ndutu, central Serengeti, Ngorongoro.

See [Serengeti in the green season](/blog/serengeti-in-the-green-season/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
